demo.title: The Signature Wool Overcoat
demo.shortDescription: Meticulously tailored from 100% Italian virgin wool. Features a classic double-breasted silhouette with horn buttons and a cupro lining for an impeccable drape.
demo.description: The Signature Wool Overcoat is constructed from a premium Italian wool blend that offers exceptional warmth without the bulk. The interior is fully lined with silky cupro, ensuring smooth layering over heavy knitwear. The silhouette is deliberately oversized to accommodate modern styling while maintaining clean, architectural lines.
demo.fit: Relaxed/Oversized. Size down for a tailored fit.
demo.care: Dry clean only. Do not tumble dry.
demo.reviewOne: I've ordered three times from this store and the quality is consistently amazing. The wool coat fits perfectly.
demo.reviewTwo: The fabric feels substantial and the cut is impeccable. Worth every penny.
demo.reviewThree: Shipping was quick and the packaging was beautiful. A genuinely premium experience.
